historical_qualifications: 2024/25 are development-exposed retrospective evaluation; 2026 is descriptive.
Point and residual selection use eligible earlier pre-2024 evidence.
Annual residual-distribution transfer to weekly, event and current heads is unvalidated; no promoted or calibrated betting claim.
Historical prices are qualified strict-contract probability proxies, not executable quotes or profit.
Selected contract cohorts differ by provider: 120 Kalshi and 92 Polymarket games; DraftKings is unavailable for this historical T1 contract study.
Paired week-bootstrap intervals are descriptive and not multiplicity-adjusted.
